sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OFFBEAT/2026 Offbeat Collection Wholesale Rates (30%) AMENDED.pdf
notes: This one PDF ('2026 Offbeat Collection Wholesale Rates') covers 8 distinct properties/products under the Offbeat Safaris Holdings umbrella: Offbeat Mara Camp, Offbeat Ndoto, Sosian Lodge, Sosian Horse Riding Safaris, Ekorian's Mugie Camp, Deloraine House, The Cabanas, Offbeat Riding Safaris - one JSON file written per property.
Wholesale rate confirmed arithmetically as Rack x 0.70 for Offbeat Mara Camp (e.g. Green adult: $406 = $580 x 0.70). This is a Wholesale/STO 30% tier.

conservancyFees_perPersonPerNight.confidenceNote: Subject to change, will be charged at the prevailing 2026 rate.

specials: Family Discount: 3rd child (4-11yrs) sharing a triple pays conservancy fees only. All seasons, combinable with 4 & 5.
Honeymoon Discount: 25% off accommodation rate for one of the couple. All seasons.
Per Single rate only charged from the 2nd single room per booking (first single pays per-adult-sharing rate). All seasons, combinable with 4 & 5.
4 nights for the price of 3 (conservancy fees payable for all nights). Regular/Mid/Green seasons, combinable with 1 & 3.
6 nights for the price of 5 (conservancy fees payable for all nights) when booking Ekorian for 3 nights in Green/Regular + Offbeat Mara for 3 nights in Regular/Mid/Green. Combinable with 1 & 3.
includes: Visits to Koiyaki Guiding School/Aitong School
Exclusive use of vehicle for groups of 4+ pax
excludes: Late departure after 2pm: US$100pp (incl. lunch & game drive)
Visit to a Masai village: US$30/adult, US$15/child (book/pay in advance)
Exclusive use of game viewing vehicle: US$300/vehicle/day
Exclusive use of customised photographic vehicle: US$375/vehicle/day
Maasai Mara National Reserve fees additional: Jan-Jun US$100/adult, US$50/child/day; Jul-Dec US$200/adult, US$50/child/day
Vehicle transfers in/out of Mara North Conservancy (rates on request)

policies.deposit: 20% deposit confirms booking; balance due 45 days prior to arrival. Provisional bookings expire ~2 weeks from booking date unless extended.
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded (net of bank charges); 120-46 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 45-30 days: 50% of full booking value forfeited; <30 days or no-show: 100% forfeited. No refund for early departure.
policies.seasonChangeOnAmendment: If an amended booking falls in a different season, new season rates apply.
